steps.text: 1. The Admin opens the "Review tours" page (queue).

2. The system returns tours in "AI Warning" or "Pending review": AI Warning first, then the longest-waiting tours first; each row has the name, status, the number of AI / location reasons, city · tour type and the submission time. E1, E2.

exceptions.text: E1. No tours pending → "No tours waiting for review".
E2. No valid token → 401; not an Admin → 403, the client shows "Only administrators can view this page".

steps.text: 4. The system shows the read-only record: tour information, moderation reasons (field, category, AI / location source, severity), the places (description, photos, audio, trigger zone, moderation status of each place), the route and the decision history. A1, E3.

exceptions.text: E3. Invalid tour ID format → 400; the tour does not exist → 404, the client shows "This tour was not found".

steps.text: 5. The Admin chooses "Approve" and confirms "Approve this tour?". A2, A3.

exceptions.text: E5. Reject / request changes without a reason or over 1000 characters → 422 ("Please enter a reason" / "Reason has at most 1000 characters"), the error shows in the dialog.

steps.text: 6. The system moves the tour to "Public" with a conditional update statement (only if the tour is still pending), writing the review history and the Admin action log in the same transaction. E4.

exceptions.text: E4. The tour is no longer pending (another Admin decided first) → 409 "The tour is no longer pending review" and the record reloads.

steps.text: 7. The system publishes the tour.approved event (and tour.published for the chatbot); Notification creates an in-app notification and sends an email to the author (UC#16). E6.

exceptions.text: E6. Sending the event fails → only logged; the decision still succeeds.

steps.text: 8. The client shows "Tour approved, the tour is now public" and goes back to the queue; the tour appears in search and can be downloaded.

steps: A1. View the content: the Admin listens to the audio, opens photos and views the route right in the record; the record is read-only, with no content edit buttons.
A2.1. The Admin chooses "Reject", enters a reason (required, 1–1000 characters) and taps "Reject tour". E5.

A2.2. The system moves the tour to "Rejected", stores the reason, writes the log and publishes tour.rejected; the author receives a notification and an email with the reason; the client shows "Tour rejected" and goes back to the queue.
A3.1. The Admin chooses "Request changes", enters a general reason and / or notes per place (at least one field), then taps "Send change request". E5.

A3.2. The system joins them into one reason ("Place 2 – <name>: <note>"), moves the tour to "Needs changes", writes the log and publishes tour.changes_requested; the author receives "Tour needs changes"; the client shows "Change request sent to the author" and goes back to the queue.
